work_items.title: Foundation — shell/background camera+moveend wiring, pure order-state logic, i18n
acceptance_criteria: CustomerMapBackground accepts onCenterChange and fires it (debounced via createMoveendDebouncer) on Leaflet moveend, reading map.getCenter(); it renders a center-pin overlay; cameraTarget still drives setView/fitBounds. All leaflet stays inside this lazy chunk.
CustomerMapShell threads cameraTarget + onCenterChange to CustomerMapBackground while preserving exactly-once ensureFleetSlug/enableSilentRefresh behavior and its tests.
orderFlowState.ts is a pure selection state machine (search vs destinationSet; select/clear destination, set pickup) with tests.
orderCamera.ts purely returns CameraInput points (0/1/>=2) from pickup + optional destination, with no leaflet import.

buildOrderRequest.ts maps PriceQuoteView -> priceType (Fixed/Estimate/Meter) + fixedPriceCzk/routeId or estimatedPriceCzk, with clamped passengers, ISO/null scheduledAt, trimmed/null note. It supersedes the hardcoded-Estimate path.
All new UC-015 i18n keys are added to all 6 locale JSONs (customer formal 'vy'); parity and formatStaysCs tests stay green; money cs-CZ/Kc and dates Europe/Prague in every locale.
test_cases: orderFlowState: selectDestination/clearDestination/setPickup transitions flip phase correctly.
orderCamera: 0 points -> empty; 1 point -> single (setView); 2 points (pickup+destination) -> both (fitBounds).
buildOrderRequest: Fixed view -> priceType 'Fixed' + fixedPriceCzk/routeId; Estimate view -> priceType 'Estimate' + estimatedPriceCzk; passengers clamped; scheduledAt ISO/null; note trimmed->null.

CustomerMapBackground (mock react-leaflet + useGeoConfig + leafletSetup): firing moveend calls onCenterChange after debounce (fake timers); center-pin renders; cameraTarget drives the controller; never mount a real MapContainer.
CustomerMapShell: cameraTarget/onCenterChange thread through; exactly-once ensureFleetSlug/enableSilentRefresh preserved.
i18n parity across 6 locales stays green.
work_items.notes: Sanctioned EXTENSION, not a rebuild: centerPin.ts's own comment defers moveend wiring to 'UC-015 consumers' and CustomerMapShell/Background are the files UC-014 left 'filled by UC-015/016'. In-map controller reads useMap().getZoom() for CameraInput.currentZoom so the page never invents a zoom. Reuse mapCamera.cameraIntent/CameraInput; do not re-derive setView vs fitBounds in the page. Pure modules import nothing from leaflet (stay eager-safe like mapCamera.ts). client.ts is read-only here (GeoSuggestItem coords are non-optional; CreateOrderRequest/PriceType already exist).

work_items.title: Top search overlay (Kam to bude?) — useSuggest results, keyboard nav, select->destination
acceptance_criteria: Rendered in the shell topSlot: a 'Kam to bude?' input that, on typing >=3 chars, expands a suggestions overlay backed by useSuggest (anonymous-by-slug, works logged-out).
Each suggestion shows label + municipality; selecting one calls onSelectDestination with a SelectedPlace (label+coords, no geocode needed).
Keyboard nav: ArrowUp/Down move active option, Enter selects, Escape collapses; combobox/listbox ARIA (role, aria-expanded, aria-activedescendant).
Empty-results (useSuggest.isEmpty) shows a no-results message (not an error); pending shows SearchingLoader.
Presentational: page owns state; component only calls back.
test_cases: DestinationSearch (mock @/shared/api/client): typing >=3 chars shows suggestions (Czech default).
ArrowDown + Enter selects and fires onSelectDestination with coords.
Escape collapses the overlay.
Empty-state renders the no-results message; pending renders the loader.
Axe: no violations on the interactive component.
work_items.notes: Reuse useSuggest directly (do NOT rebuild suggest logic); AddressAutocomplete is the presentation reference and is removed in WI-4. GeoSuggestItem lat/lng are non-optional so selection needs no getGeoGeocode call. New i18n keys already landed in WI-1 — keep parity green (no new keys expected here; if any, add to all 6).

work_items.title: Price bottom sheet + options + inline login + create-order
acceptance_criteria: Rendered in the shell bottomSlot via BottomSheet: PriceRangeBadge shows Fixed (exact), Estimate (range low-high, never single), Meter, or error (errorKey).
Primary Order ('Objednat') + Cancel/clear ('Zrusit'); Cancel resets destination (callback to page -> back to search phase).
Expandable ride-options area (collapsed by default, drives BottomSheet.expanded): PassengerStepper, WhenPicker (min/max via whenRules), note input — all reused.

Order click: offline (useOnlineStatus) -> visible blocked reason, no submit; logged-out -> CustomerLoginStep rendered inside the sheet with all order state preserved, auto-resume create on onAuthenticated; logged-in -> buildOrderRequest + useCreateOrder.mutateAsync -> onOrdered(publicCode). Never queued offline.
Meter/unavailable view disables Order with the fallback message.
Axe clean; primary button >=48px; Escape closes the sheet.
test_cases: PriceSheet (mock @/shared/api/client): Fixed view shows exact price; Estimate shows a range (low-high, never single).
Meter/error disables Order and shows the fallback message.
Cancel fires onCancel.
Order logged-out -> inline CustomerLoginStep appears without losing state -> on auth, create fires and onOrdered(publicCode) is called.
Offline (useOnlineStatus false) blocks Order with a visible reason; create is not called.
Escape closes the sheet; Axe: no violations.
work_items.notes: Connection gate is useOnlineStatus (navigator.onLine), NOT isServerActionBlocked: the customer PWA holds no SignalR fleet-hub connection while ordering (the hub connects only on the tracking screen). This is the correct customer-side realization of web-realtime.md#offline-ux (block create with a visible reason; never queue — a stale order is worse than a failed one). Mirror CustomOrderPage's handleSubmitClick -> showLogin -> submit(onAuthenticated) continuation exactly so order state survives inline login. Pass usePriceQuote({ allowAnonymous: true }) so logged-out customers see Fixed prices.

work_items.title: Page assembly + router (SIBLING of CustomerLayout) + remove old screens + rewrite create-order e2e
acceptance_criteria: MapOrderPage owns orderFlowState and composes CustomerMapShell with topSlot=DestinationSearch and bottomSlot=PriceSheet (sheet shown once a destination is set).

Pickup defaults to GPS/center-pin (UC-014); moving the map fires onCenterChange -> debounced useReverseGeocode -> pickup label updates. cameraTarget uses orderCamera points (setView pickup only; fitBounds pickup+destination once destination set).
usePriceQuote({ allowAnonymous:true }) drives the sheet; PriceSheet.onOrdered(publicCode) -> navigate('/customer/t/'+publicCode). TrackingPage is untouched.

Router mounts MapOrderPage at /customer as a SIBLING of the CustomerLayout group (mirroring /customer/login), lazily. /customer/history and /customer/t/:code stay reachable; /customer/order/route/:routeId, /customer/order/new, and the old CustomerHomePage index route are removed.

Old screens deleted with colocated tests: CustomerHomePage, RouteCard, ActiveOrderBanner, useCommonRoutes, homeContent, CustomOrderPage, RouteOrderPage, useRouteOrder, AddressAutocomplete, PickupMap, PickupMapInner. No dangling imports (tsc green). useMyActiveOrder, useSuggest, usePriceQuote, PriceRangeBadge, PassengerStepper, WhenPicker, whenRules, orderForm, priceQuote, useCreateOrder are KEPT.
The create-order e2e is rewritten to the map-first path (search -> suggestion -> price sheet -> Order -> inline phone+code login -> /customer/t/...), cs-CZ, reusing the SMS-hash injection harness.
test_cases: MapOrderPage (mock @/shared/api/client + react-leaflet + useGeoConfig + leafletSetup): selecting a destination shows the price sheet; camera points reflect pickup+destination; onOrdered navigates to /customer/t/:code (mock useNavigate). Axe on the assembled page.
Full customer vitest suite green after removals (no broken imports).
e2e Customer map-first create-order: goto /customer -> type destination -> pick suggestion -> Order -> inline login (injectForPhone + DEV_SMS_CODE) -> lands on /customer/t/ with 'Hledame ridice...'.
work_items.notes: tsc is the primary automated gate here because it catches dangling imports from the removals. Keep useMyActiveOrder (referenced by history; needed by UC-016) and useSuggest (reused by DestinationSearch). Do NOT modify TrackingPage — UC-016 replaces it; UC-015 only navigates to /customer/t/:code by publicCode. The e2e rewrite moots the old {routes}/{items} common-routes bug (common-routes home is deleted). Playwright is justified: this is the critical create-order flow. Conductor runs the full lint/vitest/build/size/e2e gate pre-commit.
